summary: Well-structured test suite with comprehensive coverage of core requirements (read_version, determine_bump, bump_version, write_version, generate_changelog) and proper e2e validation. Good use of unit tests via source-based function testing, proper test isolation with setup/teardown, and fixture-based approach. Workflow structure tests validate actionlint and reference integrity. Weaknesses: limited edge case coverage (malformed JSON without version field, case sensitivity in commit types, empty files, unusual commit formatting); workflow tests use fragile grep patterns instead of YAML parsing; fixture files are referenced but not shown, so content assumptions are implicit. Would catch most regressions in happy-path and basic error scenarios but may miss subtle bugs in edge cases or unusual input formats.
